decisions.decision: The Board began the process of revoking Central Mass Power Sport's license for Class 1 & Class 3 Automotive, starting on the next business day, for failing to submit renewal paperwork.
decisions.quote: the board saw fit to begin the process of revoking their license for class 1 & class 3 automotive on the next business day.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The ICMA performance measurement database is offered to members for purchase at a yearly cost; no money is in the budget for it.
budget_items.quote: this is a data base that is available to members of the icma for purchase at a cost of $995.00 per year.

budget_items.topic: Proposed use of MILA insurance savings for CPM 101 purchase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager proposed using insurance-provider savings, about $7000, to pay for the performance measurement purchase, which has no budget money.
budget_items.quote: she would like to use monies from the savings that have been incurred through initiatives with the town's insurance provider, mila, which add up to approximately $7000 for this purchase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Re-bid garage doors for the DPW renovation came in well below the original bid; the project is reported to be completely within budget.
budget_items.quote: the original bid was for approximately $66,000. the lowest bid this time came from a local company with a good reputation and was for $31,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town received savings from making one early payment to its property, casualty and workers' compensation insurance on July 1 of 2011.
budget_items.quote: the town received $23,329 in savings simply by making one early payment to the property, casualty and worker's compensation insurance on july 1ª of 2011.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town received grants and rewards from MIIA for taking part in free training and optional building inspections.
budget_items.quote: there was also $7329 in grants/rewards from miia received by the town by taking part in free training sessions and optional building inspections.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Federal reimbursement is awaited; amounts submitted were for debris removal and for monitoring.
budget_items.quote: $626,000 was submitted for debris removal and $58,000. was submitted for monitoring.
